operation_details.item: The user prefers formal legalistic wording with liability disclaimers in client presentation scripts instead of persuasive creative storytelling.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How would you like to structure the presentation of the three packaging design directions for the food brand client?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the presentation to compare the directions clearly and explain the creative rationale behind each one.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. Should the script emphasize persuasive storytelling, concise visual descriptions, or a more formal presentation style?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For client presentation scripts, I want formal legalistic wording with liability disclaimers in every paragraph instead of persuasive creative storytelling.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can structure the script as a formal comparison, with each paragraph describing the relevant design direction and stating that the observations are subject to client review, approval, and applicable production constraints.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please keep the wording suitable for speaking aloud while retaining that formal legal tone.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly. I will use measured language, avoid unsupported performance claims, and include a disclaimer in each paragraph.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Draft the talking points with placeholders for the names and visual details of the three directions.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message:
Direction One — [Name]: This direction is presented for consideration as a proposed packaging solution characterized by [visual details]. Subject to client approval and final production validation, these elements may support the intended presentation of the product; however, no representation is made regarding commercial performance, consumer response, or regulatory suitability.

Direction Two — [Name]: This direction is presented as an alternative approach incorporating [visual details]. Subject to confirmation of the applicable brand, production, and market requirements, the approach may provide a distinct visual expression; however, the client remains responsible for determining whether the proposed elements satisfy all relevant legal, commercial, and operational criteria.

Direction Three — [Name]: This direction is presented for comparative evaluation and includes [visual details]. Subject to further review, refinement, and technical testing, the proposed treatment may offer a separate interpretation of the packaging brief; however, all conclusions remain preliminary and are provided without warranty concerning implementation, consumer interpretation, or market results.

Recommendation: Based solely on the current review, [selected direction] may warrant further development because of [stated rationale]. This observation is non-binding and subject to the client’s independent assessment, approval of final artwork, and confirmation that all applicable requirements have been satisfied.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That structure works. Keep the disclaimers integrated into the spoken paragraphs rather than placing them in a separate closing section.
